intent: Individually teach gym as destination when raining without invented classes, shallow-end beginners without numeric depth, twice whistle blows with silent t preserved, referee stop after injury without inferred resumption, silver medal/event without composition proof, every opponent subset, must respect even when losing without actual-loss inference, and each runner completed one lap using explicitly new three-runner example. Six changing diagrams, one order task and one exact evidence task; no new bitmap needed.

transfer.stem: 换成铃声、规则和画画，哪组三句保留全部信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
图书管理员打了两次铃。即使累了，我们也必须遵守规则。每个孩子都完成了一幅画。
词语提示：librarian图书管理员；rang the bell打铃；drawing画。

options.text: The librarian rang the bell once. We must follow the rules even when we are tired. Each child completed one drawing.
The librarian rang the bell twice. We must follow the rules only when we are not tired. Each child completed one drawing.
The librarian rang the bell twice. We must follow the rules even when we are tired. Each child completed one drawing.
The librarian rang the bell twice. We must follow the rules even when we are tired. Only one child completed one drawing.

answer.display: The librarian rang the bell twice. We must follow the rules even when we are tired. Each child completed one drawing.

explanation.strategy: 先数两次，再保留即使累了也必须的要求，最后核对每个孩子都完成一幅。

steps.text: The librarian rang the bell twice.
We must follow the rules even when we are tired.
steps.reason: must是必须；even when tired不能变成只有不累时。
Each覆盖每个孩子，completed是已经完成，one是一幅。

distractors.reason: only when we are not tired把累时也必须改成只在不累时。
Only one child把每个孩子缩成只有一个。

explanation.pitfall: 次数、适用条件和每人的范围都要核对；要求不等于已经发生的结果。
explanation.transfer: 如果把Each child换成Only one child，完成画的人数范围会怎样改变？

picturePurpose: Code-owned diagrams let learners change destination and time, shallow/deep areas and users, whistle count, handshake scope, conditional requirements and each-runner laps. Exact record selection and a reversible timeline preserve evidence and order; no bitmap is needed to explain these changing relationships.
